extra_vocab.en: a paper that shows you paid for something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於購物、報帳與退貨情境，指付款後拿到的「收據」；在正式信件中也常用 receipt of 表示「收到…」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: receipt 的 p 不發音，唸 /rɪˈsiːt/；on／upon receipt of 後面接名詞，表示「一收到…就」。

example.en: Staff must save all travel receipts for the accounting office.
example.zh: 員工必須保存所有差旅收據交給會計部門。

example.en: Keep the receipt because we cannot refund without it.
example.zh: 請保留收據，因為沒有收據我們無法退款。

example.en: Do you have a receipt for this purchase?
example.zh: 你有這筆購買的收據嗎？

example.en: We will ship the order upon receipt of your payment.
example.zh: 我們一收到您的款項就會出貨。

example.en: Please confirm receipt of this email by tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 請在明天早上前回信確認收到這封郵件。

examples.en: Attach every receipt to your expense report before submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交費用報告前，請把每張收據都附上。

examples.en: The clerk handed me a receipt after I paid the bill.
examples.zh: 我付完帳後，店員遞給我一張收據。

examples.en: Thank you for your payment. A receipt will be emailed to you.
examples.zh: 感謝您的付款，收據將以電子郵件寄給您。

confusable.diff: invoice 是賣方要求付款的請款單，通常付款前收到；receipt 是付款後拿到的收據。

example.en: After we pay the invoice, please send us a receipt.
example.zh: 我們付完請款單之後，請寄一張收據給我們。

confusable.diff: recipe 是食譜，唸 /ˈresəpi/；兩個字拼法相近，但意思和發音都不同。

example.en: The chef shared a recipe for a simple vegetable soup.
example.zh: 主廚分享了一道簡單蔬菜湯的食譜。

similar.diff: proof of purchase 是較正式的說法，可指收據或其他購買證明。

example.en: Show proof of purchase if you want to return the product.
example.zh: 如果想退貨，請出示購買證明。

example.en: The invoice must be paid within thirty days.
example.zh: 這張請款單必須在三十天內付清。

example.en: The restaurant bill was higher than we expected.
example.zh: 餐廳的帳單比我們預期的高。

example.en: You will get a full refund within seven days.
example.zh: 您將在七天內收到全額退款。

senses.en: a paper that shows you paid for something

example.en: The receipt shows that the laptop cost nine hundred dollars.
example.zh: 收據顯示這台筆電花了九百美元。

senses.distinguish: 常出現在 on receipt of、receipt of 後面接物品或款項，指「收到」這個動作。

example.en: Receipt of the shipment was delayed by bad weather.
example.zh: 貨物的收取因壞天氣而延遲。

extra_vocab.zh: 接待處、櫃檯；招待會；反應；收訊
extra_vocab.en: the place in a building where visitors first check in
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司與飯店的訪客接待，也常指歡迎會或婚宴；描述新產品、新政策的「反應」與手機「收訊」時也會用到。

example.en: The hotel hosts several receptions for business groups each month.
example.zh: 這間飯店每個月為商務團體舉辦數場招待會。

example.en: Please sign in at the reception desk when you arrive.
example.zh: 抵達時請在接待櫃檯簽到。

example.en: The company will hold a welcome reception for guests tonight.
example.zh: 公司今晚將為賓客舉辦歡迎會。

example.en: The new manager got a warm reception from the team.
example.zh: 新經理受到團隊熱烈的歡迎。

example.en: I missed your call because the reception was poor in the elevator.
example.zh: 電梯裡收訊不良，所以我錯過了你的來電。

examples.en: Visitors should check in at the reception on the first floor.
examples.zh: 訪客應該在一樓的接待處登記。

examples.en: The wedding reception will begin at six in the hotel garden.
examples.zh: 婚宴將在六點於飯店花園開始。

examples.en: The new product received a positive reception from customers.
examples.zh: 這項新產品受到顧客的正面回應。

confusable.diff: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ 是收據；reception /rɪˈsepʃn/ 是接待處或招待會，兩字拼法相近。

example.en: Ask for a receipt at the reception desk after you pay.
example.zh: 付完錢後，請向接待櫃檯索取收據。

similar.diff: front desk 常用在飯店與辦公室，語氣比較口語；reception 還可以指招待會。

example.en: Please leave the keys at the front desk when you leave.
example.zh: 離開時請把鑰匙留在櫃檯。

example.en: Please wait in the lobby until your name is called.
example.zh: 請在大廳等候，直到叫到您的名字。

example.en: Each guest will receive a name tag at the entrance.
example.zh: 每位賓客在入口處都會拿到一張名牌。

example.en: Do you have an appointment with Ms. Lee this morning?
example.zh: 你今天早上和李小姐有預約嗎？

derived.link: reception + -ist，做這種工作的人，像 artist、tourist

senses.en: the place where visitors first check in at a company or hotel

example.en: Please leave your package at reception and we will deliver it.
example.zh: 請把包裹留在接待處，我們會幫您送達。

senses.en: a formal party to welcome people
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 wedding、welcome 等字，或接 held、attend 等動詞。

example.en: The mayor attended a reception for foreign business leaders.
example.zh: 市長出席了為外國企業領袖舉辦的招待會。

senses.en: the way people react to something new
senses.distinguish: 常搭配 warm、positive、mixed 等形容詞，主詞多為產品、計畫或政策。

example.en: The new policy had a mixed reception among employees.
example.zh: 這項新政策在員工之間反應不一。

senses.en: the quality of a phone or radio signal
senses.distinguish: 和 good、poor、weak 連用，談的是手機或廣播訊號。

example.en: The reception is weak in the conference room.
example.zh: 會議室裡的收訊很弱。

extra_vocab.en: a person who greets visitors and answers phone calls at an office or hotel
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室、飯店與診所情境，負責接待訪客、接電話和轉達訊息；也常出現在徵才廣告中。

example.en: All receptionists must attend the customer service training on Monday.
example.zh: 所有櫃檯接待人員都必須參加星期一的客服訓練。

example.en: She has worked as a hotel receptionist for three years.
example.zh: 她擔任飯店櫃檯人員已經三年了。

example.en: If you are lost, ask the receptionist for directions.
example.zh: 如果你迷路了，可以向櫃檯人員問路。

example.en: The front desk receptionist will print your visitor badge.
example.zh: 前台接待人員會幫你列印訪客證。

collocations.phrase: leave a message with the receptionist

example.en: Please leave a message with the receptionist if I am out.
example.zh: 如果我外出，請留言給櫃檯人員。

examples.en: The receptionist greeted the visitors and gave them name tags.
examples.zh: 櫃檯人員歡迎訪客並給了他們名牌。

examples.en: Our receptionist answers calls and directs them to the right person.
examples.zh: 我們的櫃檯人員負責接電話並轉給適當的人。

examples.en: We are looking for a friendly receptionist to join our office.
examples.zh: 我們正在尋找友善的櫃檯人員加入辦公室。

similar.diff: secretary 主要協助主管處理行程與文件；receptionist 負責接待訪客與接電話。

example.en: The secretary booked the meeting room for our manager.
example.zh: 秘書為我們的經理預約了會議室。

similar.diff: front desk clerk 常指飯店櫃檯的服務人員，包含辦理入住與退房。

example.en: The front desk clerk gave us two keys for the room.
example.zh: 飯店櫃檯人員給了我們兩把房間鑰匙。

example.en: My assistant will send you the meeting notes today.
example.zh: 我的助理今天會把會議記錄寄給你。

example.en: The clerk checked the price before scanning the item.
example.zh: 店員在掃描商品前先確認了價格。

example.en: Every visitor must wear a badge inside the building.
example.zh: 每位訪客在大樓內都必須配戴識別證。

derived.link: receptionist 去掉 -ist 就是 reception；加上 -ist 表示做這種工作的人，像 artist、tourist

extra_vocab.en: to collect used things and make them into new things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於環保公告、公司政策與製造情境，指把紙、塑膠、玻璃等回收再製；常搭配 recycled materials 與 recycling program。

example.en: Our company recycles all paper and plastic waste every week.
example.zh: 我們公司每週都回收所有紙類和塑膠廢棄物。

example.en: The company recycled over ten tons of paper last year.
example.zh: 這家公司去年回收了超過十噸的紙。

example.en: We are recycling old computers instead of throwing them away.
example.zh: 我們正在回收舊電腦，而不是把它們丟掉。

example.en: Our office tries to recycle paper whenever it can.
example.zh: 我們辦公室盡可能回收紙張。

example.en: All of our shopping bags are made from recycled materials.
example.zh: 我們所有的購物袋都是用再生材料製成的。

example.en: Put empty bottles in the recycling bin next to the door.
example.zh: 請把空瓶放進門旁的回收桶。

example.en: The city started a recycling program for local businesses.
example.zh: 市政府為當地企業推出了回收計畫。

examples.en: Please recycle paper and plastic bottles in the blue bins.
examples.zh: 請把紙和塑膠瓶丟進藍色回收桶。

examples.en: The factory recycles water to lower its production costs.
examples.zh: 這間工廠回收用水以降低生產成本。

examples.en: Customers can recycle old phones at any of our stores.
examples.zh: 顧客可以在我們任何一間門市回收舊手機。

similar.diff: reuse 是直接再用一次，不必加工；recycle 是把舊東西加工做成新東西。

example.en: We reuse shipping boxes instead of buying new ones every time.
example.zh: 我們重複使用運送用的紙箱，而不是每次都買新的。

example.en: The new system helps reduce waste in the kitchen.
example.zh: 新系統有助於減少廚房的廢棄物。

example.en: Our new factory is designed to protect the environment.
example.zh: 我們的新工廠設計上是為了保護環境。

example.en: We plan to reduce packaging costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 我們計畫把包裝成本降低百分之十。

example.en: Glass bottles are easy to recycle in this city.
example.zh: 在這座城市，玻璃瓶很容易回收。

example.en: We print our brochures on recycled paper to protect nature.
example.zh: 我們把宣傳冊印在再生紙上以保護自然。

extra_vocab.en: a person who gets something, such as a letter, a gift, or an award
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於電子郵件、物流與頒獎情境，指「收到東西的人」，與寄件人 sender 相對；常搭配 of 說明收到什麼。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: recipient 後面常接 of 說明收到的東西（the recipient of an award）；和寄件人相對時用 sender。

example.en: All recipients must reply to this email by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 所有收件人都必須在星期五下午前回覆這封郵件。

example.en: This message is only for the intended recipient.
example.zh: 這則訊息僅供預定的收件人閱讀。

example.en: The company was the recipient of a large government grant.
example.zh: 這家公司獲得了一筆龐大的政府補助。

example.en: The award recipient will give a short speech tonight.
example.zh: 獲獎者今晚將發表簡短的演說。

example.en: You can add more than one email recipient in this field.
example.zh: 你可以在這一欄加入不只一位電子郵件收件人。

examples.en: Please make sure the recipient's address is correct before you send it.
examples.zh: 寄出前請確認收件人的地址正確。

examples.en: The courier asked the recipient to sign for the package.
examples.zh: 快遞員請收件人簽收包裹。

examples.en: Each recipient will receive a gift card by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 每位受贈者將在月底前收到一張禮物卡。

confusable.diff: recipient 是收到東西的「人」；receipt 是付款後拿到的「收據」，是物品。

example.en: The recipient signed the form, and the driver gave him a receipt.
example.zh: 收件人在表格上簽名，司機則給了他一張收據。

similar.diff: receiver 也可指接收的人或設備（如電話聽筒）；recipient 多指收到信件、獎金或物品的人。

example.en: The receiver of the package was not at home yesterday.
example.zh: 包裹的收件人昨天不在家。

example.en: The sender's name is printed on the back of the envelope.
example.zh: 寄件人的姓名印在信封背面。

example.en: Please write your home address clearly on the form.
example.zh: 請在表格上清楚寫下你的住家地址。

example.en: The package will arrive at your office on Wednesday.
example.zh: 包裹星期三會送到你的辦公室。

extra_vocab.en: to write something again so that it is better
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室與編輯情境，指因主管或客戶的意見而「重寫」報告、信件、合約或文案；也可以當名詞表示「改寫稿」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: rewrite 是不規則動詞：rewrite – rewrote – rewritten，變化和 write 相同，不加 -ed。

example.en: He rewrites every speech until it sounds natural and clear.
example.zh: 他會一直重寫每篇演講稿，直到聽起來自然又清楚。

example.en: She rewrote the report after the manager gave feedback.
example.zh: 經理給了意見後，她重寫了這份報告。

example.en: The contract has been rewritten and is ready for review.
example.zh: 合約已經重寫完成，可以審閱了。

example.en: I am rewriting the user guide to make it simpler.
example.zh: 我正在重寫使用手冊，讓它更簡單易懂。

example.en: We decided to rewrite the whole proposal from scratch.
example.zh: 我們決定把整份提案從頭重寫。

example.en: I need to rewrite this report before the meeting.
example.zh: 我必須在會議前重寫這份報告。

example.en: Could you rewrite the draft by tomorrow noon?
example.zh: 你能在明天中午前重寫草稿嗎？

example.en: The old website needs a complete rewrite, not small fixes.
example.zh: 舊網站需要全面改寫，而不是小幅修補。

examples.en: Please rewrite this email in a more polite tone.
examples.zh: 請用更有禮貌的語氣重寫這封電子郵件。

examples.en: We may have to rewrite the ad if the client says no.
examples.zh: 如果客戶不同意，我們可能得重寫這則廣告。

examples.en: Don't rewrite the whole document; just fix the numbers.
examples.zh: 不用重寫整份文件，只要修正數字就好。

similar.diff: revise 是修改其中一部分內容；rewrite 是大幅度甚至整個重寫。

example.en: Please revise the schedule if any dates have changed.
example.zh: 如果有日期變動，請修改時程表。

similar.diff: edit 是整理文字、修正錯誤，不一定要重寫句子。

example.en: Our assistant will edit the report for spelling mistakes.
example.zh: 我們的助理會檢查並修改報告裡的拼字錯誤。

example.en: Please send me the first draft by Monday morning.
example.zh: 請在星期一早上前把初稿寄給我。

example.en: The latest version of the file is on the shared drive.
example.zh: 這份檔案的最新版本在共用硬碟上。

example.en: Please save the document before you close the program.
example.zh: 關閉程式前請先儲存文件。

example.en: Please rewrite the first paragraph so it sounds more formal.
example.zh: 請重寫第一段，讓它聽起來更正式。

example.en: The manager asked for a quick rewrite of the notice.
example.zh: 經理要求盡快改寫這份通知。

extra_vocab.en: a person who answers questions in a survey
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於市場調查與問卷報告，指「回答問卷的人」，常以複數出現，如 respondents said、most respondents。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: respond 後面用 to（respond to a survey）；respondent 也常說 respondents to the survey，不是 respondents of。

example.en: About seventy respondents completed the online customer survey.
example.zh: 大約七十位受訪者填完了線上顧客問卷。

example.en: Survey respondents were asked about their shopping habits.
example.zh: 問卷填答者被問到他們的購物習慣。

example.en: The majority of respondents prefer working from home.
example.zh: 大多數受訪者比較喜歡在家工作。

example.en: The number of respondents rose after we sent a reminder.
example.zh: 我們寄出提醒後，受訪者人數增加了。

example.en: Respondents to the survey gave our service high scores.
example.zh: 填答問卷的人給我們的服務很高的分數。

examples.en: Each respondent answered ten questions about our new mobile app.
examples.zh: 每位受訪者都回答了十個關於我們新手機應用程式的問題。

examples.en: Every respondent will receive a small gift card for their time.
examples.zh: 每位受訪者都會收到一張小禮物卡作為謝禮。

examples.en: The respondent said the training was clear and very useful.
examples.zh: 這位受訪者說這場訓練很清楚也很有用。

confusable.diff: correspondent 是特派記者或書信往來的人；respondent 是回答問卷或問題的人。

example.en: The newspaper's London correspondent reported on the new trade rules.
example.zh: 報社駐倫敦的記者報導了新的貿易規定。

similar.diff: participant 泛指參加活動或研究的人；respondent 專指回答問卷或問題的人。

example.en: Each participant received a name tag at the workshop.
example.zh: 工作坊上每位參加者都拿到一張名牌。

similar.diff: interviewee 是被面談的人，多半是一對一；respondent 多半是填問卷的人。

example.en: The interviewee answered all questions with great confidence.
example.zh: 這位受訪者非常有自信地回答所有問題。

example.en: The survey takes only five minutes to complete.
example.zh: 這份問卷只需要五分鐘就能填完。

example.en: Please fill out the questionnaire before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請填寫問卷。

example.en: We welcome feedback from every customer about our service.
example.zh: 我們歡迎每位顧客對我們的服務提供意見。

derived.link: respond 是詞幹；respondent 是 respond + -ent，回答的人，像 student、assistant
respond 的名詞形，-d 換成 -se，像 defend → defense

extra_vocab.en: a set of steps and ingredients for cooking a dish
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、食品公司與雜誌報導情境，指料理的「食譜」；也常用 a recipe for success 比喻「成功的秘訣」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: recipe 後面用 for 說明是什麼料理或目標：a recipe for chocolate cake、a recipe for success。

example.en: We collected recipes from local chefs for our new cookbook.
example.zh: 我們為新的食譜書蒐集了當地主廚的食譜。

example.en: Follow the recipe carefully, or the cake may not rise.
example.zh: 請仔細照著食譜做，否則蛋糕可能不會膨起來。

example.en: The bakery has kept its secret recipe for fifty years.
example.zh: 這家麵包店的秘方已經保密了五十年。

example.en: She bought a recipe book for her new cooking class.
example.zh: 她為新的烹飪課買了一本食譜書。

example.en: Clear goals and teamwork are a recipe for success.
example.zh: 明確的目標和團隊合作是成功的秘訣。

examples.en: This recipe needs only five ingredients and thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 這道食譜只需要五種食材和三十分鐘。

examples.en: The magazine prints a new recipe in every monthly issue.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌每個月的每一期都刊登一道新食譜。

confusable.diff: receipt 是收據，唸 /rɪˈsiːt/；recipe 是食譜，唸 /ˈresəpi/，兩字只差 p 的位置。

example.en: Don't lose the receipt for the food you bought for the recipe.
example.zh: 別弄丟你為了這道食譜買食材的收據。

similar.diff: formula 常指產品配方或公式，較技術性；recipe 是料理的食譜。

example.en: The lab developed a new formula for the energy drink.
example.zh: 實驗室為這款能量飲料研發了新配方。

example.en: Fresh ingredients make the dish taste much better.
example.zh: 新鮮的食材讓這道菜的味道好很多。

example.en: The chef's signature dish is grilled salmon with rice.
example.zh: 主廚的招牌菜是烤鮭魚佐白飯。

example.en: The restaurant changes its menu every spring.
example.zh: 這家餐廳每年春天都會更換菜單。

senses.en: a set of steps and ingredients for cooking a dish

example.en: The chef shared his recipe on the cooking show.
example.zh: 主廚在烹飪節目上分享了他的食譜。

senses.en: a way to get a certain result
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 for 加目標（recipe for growth），談的不是料理而是做事的方法。

example.en: Their recipe for fast growth is simple: listen to customers.
example.zh: 他們快速成長的秘訣很簡單：傾聽顧客。
